levels.name: First stripe
levels.sol: r5(F P)
levels.hint: Step forward, then paint. A Repeat can do that pair five times.

levels.name: Dotted line
levels.sol: r4(F P F)
levels.hint: Paint one square, skip the next. A Repeat does the rest.

levels.name: Letter L
levels.sol: r2(r4(F P) L)
levels.hint: Both arms of the L are four squares long. Can one Repeat do both?

levels.name: Stairway
levels.sol: r4(F P L F P R)
levels.hint: Each stair is two painted squares and two turns. Repeat one stair.

levels.name: Picture frame
levels.sol: F r4(r3(F P) R)
levels.hint: Step onto the corner first. After that, every side is the same.

levels.name: Diagonal
levels.sol: r5(F P R F L)
levels.hint: The robot cannot step sideways. Paint, then take a zigzag step.

levels.name: Mountain
levels.sol: r2(r3(F P L F P R) R)
levels.hint: Climb the stairs, turn, and the same stair blocks bring you down!

levels.name: Robot compass
levels.sol: r4(r2(F P) R R r2(F) L)
levels.hint: Paint one arm, walk back to the middle, then turn to the next arm.

levels.name: Letter T
levels.sol: r2(r5(F P) L L r2(F) L)
alt: r5(F P) L L r2(F) L r5(F P)
levels.hint: The bar and the stem are both five long. Turn round to reach the stem.

levels.name: Letter Z
levels.sol: r2(r5(F P) R r4(F R F P L) L)
alt: r5(F P) R r4(F R F P L) L r4(F P)
levels.hint: A bar, a zigzag, a bar. The robot stops as soon as the Z is done.

levels.name: Doughnut
levels.sol: F f f f f|F P F P F R
levels.hint: No Repeat today. Every side of the ring is the same. Use F1!

levels.name: Big stairs
levels.sol: r2(f R f L)|r3(F P)
alt: r2(r3(F P) R r3(F P) L)
levels.hint: Every long stair is three painted squares. F1 can paint one stair.

levels.name: Diamond
levels.sol: F r4(r2(F R F P L) R)
levels.hint: Each side is a zigzag of two diagonal steps. Four sides, four turns.

levels.name: Noughts and crosses
levels.sol: r4(r5(F P) L F F L F L)
alt: r4(r5(F P) L F r2(F L))
levels.hint: Paint one line, then hop round to the start of the next. Four lines!

levels.name: Window panes
levels.sol: F R F r4(f R)|r4(r2(F P) R)
alt: F R F r4(r4(r2(F P) R) R)
levels.hint: Walk to the middle. From there each pane is a little square for F1.

levels.name: Square spiral
levels.sol: F r3(r4(P F) R) r3(r2(P F) R)
alt: r5(F P) r2(R r4(F P)) r2(R r2(F P))
levels.hint: Try Paint before Forward. Which sides of the spiral are the same?

levels.name: Kite
levels.sol: F r4(f L) R R f|r2(F R F P L)
levels.hint: F1 can paint one diagonal side. The tail is one more side!

levels.name: Zigzag line
levels.sol: F P r2(f R f L)|r2(F R F P L)
levels.hint: Up, down, up: every slope is the same diagonal. Put it in F1.

levels.name: Up arrow
levels.sol: r5(F P) r2(R R f) R f|r2(F R F P L)
levels.hint: Paint the shaft, then use F1 for the diagonals. You may paint twice!

levels.name: Three bubbles
levels.sol: F f R r4(F) f L F F f|r4(r2(F P) R)
levels.hint: Every bubble is the same ring. Draw it in F1, then hop to the next.
